problem_statement: CODIUX is the marketing site for an IT solutions and services agency, built on this Nuxt 2 template. It has a home page (hero slider, welcome, professional services, project counter, team, portfolio, quote and blog sections) plus secondary marketing pages such as /services and /about, all wrapped by a shared header and footer through the default layout. The growth team wants one consistent 'Service focus' filter that lets a visitor narrow the agency's own service catalogue by discipline (All focuses, Build, Secure and Operate) and see a live count of how many of the six CODIUX services match — the same interactive filter no matter which marketing page they land on. The filter shows a 'Service focus' heading, the focus tabs, a 'Showing N of 6 · <focus>' readout and the six service cards (Product Design, IT consultancy, Data security, IT support helpdesk, IT management, Cloud services), each tagged with its focus. Ship the filter so it (1) appears on the home, services and about pages alike (rendered once from the shared layout, not pasted per page), (2) lays out its focus tabs and service cards responsively without horizontal overflow on a phone, (3) matches the site's blue-on-light brand styling rather than an off-brand dark or washed-out slab, and (4) keeps the count readout in sync with the selected focus so a visitor who picks 'Secure' sees 'Showing 2 of 6 · Secure' and only the matching cards. Keep the rest of the site — navigation, hero slider, service cards, team and blog content and the static Nuxt build — intact with no console or network errors.
required_content: Add a shared 'Service focus' filter so it renders on the home, services and about pages (rendered once from the shared default layout, not a per-page copy).
The filter shows a 'Service focus' heading, focus tabs (All focuses, Build, Secure, Operate), a 'Showing N of 6 · <focus>' count readout, and the six CODIUX service cards each tagged with a focus.
The focus tabs and service cards must wrap responsively so no marketing page overflows horizontally on a 390px phone (overflow tolerance 24px).
Style the filter in the site's blue-on-light brand language (light cards, blue accents, navy text), consistent and legible, not an off-brand dark slab or washed-out low-contrast cards.

Wire the filter so that after clicking a focus tab (for example Secure), the count readout names the selected focus and the shown count ('Showing 2 of 6 · Secure') by reading the live selection, and the grid shows only the matching cards — not a stale captured value.
Preserve the navigation, the hero slider, the service cards, the team and blog content, and the static Nuxt build with no console or network errors.
author_notes: Built on the Klodovsky CODIUX Nuxt 2 IT-solutions agency template (shared header/footer via layouts/default.vue, Bootstrap grid, owl-carousel hero slider, blue #3078fb accent on a light surface, WOW reveal). The shared Service focus filter re-uses CODIUX's own six professional services and Themify/flaticon service glyphs already bundled under static/img and static/css; no remote assets are added and the brand font stack is self-hosted. Design keywords: service focus filter, marketing continuity, IT services agency catalogue, blue-on-light brand palette, responsive service cards, live result count.
design_constraints: Implement the Service focus filter as a shared component rendered from the default layout so a single source of truth reaches every marketing page; do not paste divergent copies per page or build a detached widget.

The focus-tab row and the service-card grid must use a fluid, wrapping responsive layout (no fixed-width nowrap track, no negative-margin card stacking) so they never force horizontal overflow on tablet or mobile and stay legible.

The filter must adopt the site's blue-on-light brand palette and card styling so it reads as part of CODIUX, not a foreign dark block or a washed-out low-contrast pile; keep card titles legible against their cards.

The count readout must reflect the CURRENT selected focus after every change by reading the live selection, so it can never go stale relative to the chosen focus, and the grid must show only the matching cards.
Do not remove or regress the navigation, the hero slider, the service cards, the team/blog content, the local image assets or the static build.

change_completion: The Service focus filter is present on the home, services and about pages (the shared filter reaches all three routes).

After clicking a focus tab (for example Secure) on the home page, the count readout updates to name the selected focus and count ('Showing 2 of 6 · Secure') and only the matching cards remain — the post-interaction terminal state changed from the initial 'Showing 6 of 6 · All focuses'.
design_consistency: The filter on the home states matches the reference's blue-on-light brand styling under the visual-regression gate (pixel/ssim/block-fidelity), not an off-brand dark slab or washed-out low-contrast cards.
The filter adopts the site's blue-accent card idiom so it reads as part of CODIUX across the marketing pages.
responsive: No captured marketing page overflows horizontally beyond 24px on a 390px phone; the focus tabs and card grid wrap.
mobile_initial, mobile_home_rail and tablet_initial keep the layout readable across viewports without clipping or overflow.
regression: Navigation (home/services/about), the header and footer remain present and functional.
The existing hero slider, service cards, team and blog content and the static Nuxt build are not removed or broken, with no console or network errors.

state_constraints: desktop_initial, tablet_initial and mobile_initial protect the homepage hero slider and responsive shell.
desktop_services and desktop_about protect the secondary marketing pages and must carry the Service focus filter.
mobile_services and mobile_about protect the secondary pages across viewports without horizontal overflow.
desktop_home_rail and mobile_home_rail scroll the Service focus filter into view and must show the blue-on-light filter without horizontal overflow.
scope_home clicks the Secure focus tab; the count readout must then name the selected focus ('Showing 2 of 6 · Secure') and show only the matching cards.
